responsibility: Implements the DynamicStrings-oriented wrapper layer around FIO, converting managed strings to raw filename buffers for open/exists calls and providing helpers to write an entire dynamic string or read a line from a file into a newly built DynamicStrings value. Its role is to adapt the file subsystem to the managed-string abstraction rather than to own buffering or file-descriptor state itself.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the implementation side of the SFIO pair: it actually bridges DynamicStrings to GFIO by calling DynamicStrings_string/Length and GFIO open/read/write routines, including line-reading assembly into a new DynamicStrings value. The header only publishes those entry points.
